sweet-crumb-bakery.name: Sweet Crumb Bakery
sweet-crumb-bakery.policies: Pickup only at 14 Orchard Lane, Tuesday to Saturday, 8am to 5pm. Orders need one day of notice. We bake in a kitchen that also handles nuts, wheat, eggs and dairy. Full refund if you cancel at least 24 hours before pickup.

products.name: Gluten-free vanilla cupcakes (dozen)
products.description: Twelve vanilla cupcakes made with rice and almond flour, topped with vanilla buttercream. Baked the morning of pickup.

products.name: Classic chocolate cupcakes (dozen)
products.description: Twelve dark chocolate cupcakes with whipped chocolate frosting. Our best seller for birthdays.

products.name: Sourdough country loaf
products.description: A 900g naturally leavened loaf with a crisp crust. Made with flour, water and salt only.

products.name: Lemon celebration cake (8 inch)
products.description: Three layers of lemon sponge with lemon curd and cream cheese frosting. Serves 12 to 14. A short message can be piped on top.

products.name: Oat and raisin cookies (box of 6)
products.description: Six large chewy oat cookies with raisins and cinnamon. Made without eggs or dairy.

products.name: Morning pastry box (6 pieces)
products.description: Two butter croissants, two cinnamon swirls and two fruit danishes. Best eaten the same day.
